query: What rights do I have if I am arrested?
reference: A person arrested must be told the grounds of arrest, may consult a lawyer of their choice, and must be produced before a magistrate within 24 hours.

query: Do I have a right to freedom of speech in India?
reference: Citizens have the right to freedom of speech and expression under Article 19(1)(a), subject to reasonable restrictions.

query: Is education a fundamental right for children?
reference: The State must provide free and compulsory education to children aged six to fourteen.

query: What is the punishment for murder?
reference: Murder is punishable with death or imprisonment for life, and fine (BNS 103).

query: Someone stole my phone. What does the law say about theft?
reference: Theft is dishonestly taking movable property without consent; punishable under BNS 303 with imprisonment and/or fine.

query: How do I file an FIR for a cognizable offence?
reference: Information about a cognizable offence can be given orally or electronically to the police station and is recorded as an FIR (BNSS 173).

query: Can an email or electronic record be used as evidence in court?
reference: Electronic records are admissible as documents if the conditions and certificate under BSA 63 are met.

query: I bought a defective product. Where can I file a consumer complaint?
reference: A complaint can be filed with the District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission (Consumer Protection Act 35).

query: My landlord won't return my security deposit. What does the law say?
reference: Under the Model Tenancy Act the deposit is capped (two months' rent for residential) and must be refunded on vacating; it is a model Act, not binding law until a State adopts it.

query: How much notice is needed to end a monthly lease?
reference: A month-to-month lease can be ended by 15 days' notice (Transfer of Property Act 106).

query: When must my employer pay my wages?
reference: Wages must be paid on set schedules: end of shift for daily workers, weekly, fortnightly or by the seventh day for monthly (Code on Wages 17).

query: Am I entitled to extra pay for overtime?

expected_provisions.act: Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code

reference: Overtime must be paid at twice the normal rate of wages.

query: What is the maximum number of working hours in a day?

expected_provisions.act: Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code

reference: No worker may be required to work more than eight hours in a day.

query: When am I eligible for gratuity?
reference: Gratuity is payable after five years of continuous service, on retirement, resignation, death or disablement.

query: Can workers go on strike without notice?
reference: No person employed in an industrial establishment may strike without giving notice (Industrial Relations Code 62).

query: अगर मुझे गिरफ्तार किया जाए तो मेरे क्या अधिकार हैं?
reference: गिरफ्तारी के आधार बताए जाने, वकील से सलाह लेने और 24 घंटे में मजिस्ट्रेट के सामने पेश किए जाने का अधिकार।

query: मेरा मकान मालिक सिक्योरिटी डिपॉज़िट वापस नहीं कर रहा है। कानून क्या कहता है?
reference: मॉडल टेनेंसी एक्ट में सिक्योरिटी डिपॉज़िट की सीमा (आवासीय के लिए दो माह का किराया) और वापसी का प्रावधान है; यह मॉडल एक्ट है, राज्य अपनाए तब ही लागू।

query: खराब सामान बेचने वाली दुकान के खिलाफ उपभोक्ता शिकायत कहाँ दर्ज करें?
reference: जिला उपभोक्ता विवाद निवारण आयोग में शिकायत दर्ज की जा सकती है।

query: मेरी कंपनी समय पर वेतन नहीं दे रही है, कानून क्या कहता है?
reference: मजदूरी भुगतान की समय-सीमा (दैनिक, साप्ताहिक, मासिक अगले माह की सातवीं तारीख तक) कोड ऑन वेजेज की धारा 17 में है।

query: हत्या की सज़ा क्या है?
reference: हत्या पर मृत्युदंड या आजीवन कारावास और जुर्माना (BNS 103)।

query: What is IPC 302?
reference: IPC 302 (murder) was repealed on 1 July 2024 and replaced by BNS 103.

query: What is the punishment for cheating under IPC 420?
reference: IPC 420 is repealed; cheating is now BNS 318.

query: What does Section 498A IPC say about cruelty by husband?
reference: IPC 498A is repealed; the current provision is BNS 85 (and 86 defines cruelty).

query: How is an FIR registered under Section 154 CrPC?
reference: CrPC 154 is repealed; FIR registration is now BNSS 173.

query: When can police arrest without a warrant under CrPC 41?
reference: CrPC 41 is repealed; the replacement is BNSS 35.

query: What is Section 65B of the Indian Evidence Act?
reference: IEA 65B on electronic records is repealed and replaced by BSA 63.

query: My employer has not paid my wages for two months. What can I do?
reference: Monthly wages must be paid before the end of the seventh day of the following month (Code on Wages 17). The employee can file a claim before the authority appointed to hear such claims, within three years (Code on Wages 45).

query: मेरा मालिक दो महीने से वेतन नहीं दे रहा है। मैं क्या कर सकता हूँ?
reference: मासिक मजदूरी अगले महीने की सातवीं तारीख बीतने से पहले देनी होती है (कोड ऑन वेजेज धारा 17)। कर्मचारी दावे सुनने वाले प्राधिकारी के पास तीन साल के भीतर दावा कर सकता है (धारा 45)।

query: My landlord has not returned my security deposit three months after I moved out. What can I do?
reference: Under the Model Tenancy Act the deposit must be refunded when the landlord takes back vacant possession, after deducting the tenant's liabilities (Model Tenancy Act 11); it is a model Act, not binding law until a State adopts it.

query: A shop sold me a defective phone and refuses to replace it. What can I do?
reference: A complaint can be filed with the District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission (Consumer Protection Act 35).

What is the fee for filing an RTI application?
reference: The Right to Information Rules set a fee of Rs 10 for central government applications.

query: What is the penalty for drunk driving in India?
reference: The Motor Vehicles Act penalises drunk driving with fine and/or imprisonment (Section 185), up to Rs 10,000 and 6 months for a first offence.

query: On what grounds can a Hindu couple get a divorce?
reference: The Hindu Marriage Act 1955 Section 13 lists grounds such as adultery, cruelty, desertion, conversion, and mental disorder.

query: What protection does the Domestic Violence Act give a wife?
reference: The Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act 2005 provides protection orders, residence orders and monetary relief.

query: Do I need to register for GST for a small business?
reference: GST registration is mandatory above the turnover threshold (Rs 40 lakh for goods, Rs 20 lakh for services in most States).
